name: Mizuka Shrine Tide
passives: Sacred Balance — Mizuka's Mastery: Mizuka's Spirit Balance: a solo range aperture that grows when the Titan uses shrines, mist, and mirror paths to control enemies instead of relying on allies. Counterplay remains: deny favored terrain, force reaction bait, drain Momentum or Divinity.
lore: Mizuka Shrine Tide is a colossal Kami breaker from The Sacred Kingdoms. Humans later copied fragments of this being into myth, ritual, monster lore, and sacred art, but the Titan is the older source: Kami breaker office: judgement rupture, armor sundering, trial by force; Tengu: mountain wind, discipline, masks, feathers.
personality: Ancient, immense, purposeful, and bound to the survival philosophy of its Realm.
visualDescription: Full-body living myth-source Titan, not a costume: Mizuka Shrine Tide shows torii silhouettes, shrine lacquer red, white paper shide, braided shimenawa cords, mirror discs, foxfire blue, ink-wash smoke, cedar bark, moonlit silk, oni iron, tengu feather wind, dragon-rain scales, mask geometry, seasonal petals and ash.. Role silhouette must read as Breaker. Materials include lacquered shrine red, aged cedar, white paper shide, braided straw rope, moonlit silk, black ink smoke, foxfire blue. The design must feel older than human mythology and avoid anime mecha samurai, generic ninja, literal shrine body, plastic kimono costume, random kanji text, neon cyberpunk.
developmentStatus: Combat kit, named gear, leveling hooks, and balance pass complete; artwork pending.

abilityDetails.name: Mizuka Sundering Strike
abilityDetails.effect: Deal Spirit damage at range 2; gain 8 Momentum, or 12 if used from shrine terrain or into the Titan's marked target.
abilityDetails.counterplay: Line-of-sight denial, evasion, armor, or forcing low-value targets.

abilityDetails.name: Seal Armor Rupture
abilityDetails.effect: Apply armor break, shield collapse, boss phase pressure; also builds 10 Spirit Balance when it changes enemy intent or breaks an objective action.
abilityDetails.scaling: 70% attack plus role utility scaling from energy
abilityDetails.counterplay: Interrupt before resolution, spread enemy ranks, or bait the cooldown.

abilityDetails.name: Mizuka Shrine Tide: Gatebreaker Decree
abilityDetails.effect: Spend stored Spirit Balance to create a two-round battlefield rule around shrine terrain; enemies receive a readable counter-window before the strongest effect lands.
abilityDetails.scaling: 140% attack; utility duration +1 at mastery tier 4
abilityDetails.counterplay: Move out of the rule zone, drain Momentum, or trigger the exposed recovery turn.

abilityDetails.name: Divine Ascension — Seal Spirit Unbound
abilityDetails.effect: Enter Ascendant stance for 2 rounds: +15% damage, +12 mitigation, empowered Spirit Balance, and one mythic reaction override. Ends with a one-round recovery risk.
abilityDetails.scaling: Does not stack with external ultimate buffs
abilityDetails.counterplay: Survive the window, deny objectives during recovery, or force defensive reaction spending.

equipmentDetails.name: Kami Seal Implement
equipmentDetails.effect: +4 attack. Empowered basics against vulnerable enemies generate +4 Momentum but cannot trigger more than once per round.
equipmentDetails.balanceGuardrail: No extra action generation; damage bonus capped against bosses.

equipmentDetails.name: Mizuka Shrine Tide Realmplate
equipmentDetails.effect: +2 armor and +1 resistance. First preventable hazard hit each battle is reduced by 25% if the Titan used a reaction last round.
equipmentDetails.balanceGuardrail: Hazard reduction does not prevent scripted boss mechanics.

equipmentDetails.name: Mizuka Spirit Balance Core
equipmentDetails.effect: Spirit Balance cap +20. At 80+ Spirit Balance, the next Technique gains a role-specific rider, then drains 30 Spirit Balance.
equipmentDetails.balanceGuardrail: One empowered Technique per two rounds; cannot chain with Ascension opener.

leveling.powerFormula: hp + attack*6 + range*5 + energy*7 + speed*6 + armor*2 + resistance*2 + critChance

balanceNotes.intendedDifficulty: Tuned for harder solo encounters: every Titan can win alone, but mistakes against counters starve Momentum/Divinity.
balanceNotes.primaryRole: break armor, shields, and boss windows
